name: fb-lane-coordination
description: FB connects six product workstreams to Product-led BFM implementation, automated verification, repair, and explicit release approval.

interface.shortDescription: Six workstreams, one Product-led delivery loop
interface.longDescription: FB connects Product/User, Business, Design, Tech, Discovery, and Bugs workstreams through ready handoff MD files. After Product approval, $bfm scans all six, prioritizes the ready work, directs Codex implementation, runs automated checks and bounded repair, and stops at Ready to ship. Only Push Live authorizes merge or deployment.
defaultPrompt: Start here: use $fb-lane, run doctor if setup looks incomplete, show current status and active locks, then ask what outcome I want to deliver.

Use $fb-lane to route questions through Product/User, Business, Design, Tech, Discovery, and Bugs. Each relevant workstream should investigate its question, gather evidence, recommend a path, and create a ready handoff MD file; record None relevant instead of inventing work.

Run $bfm only after Product approval. Scan all six workstreams and ready handoffs, reconcile duplicates, contradictions, dependencies, locks, and the approved goal, then prioritize and direct Codex implementation.

Own automated testing and bounded repair for the exact candidate. When the required checks pass, report Ready to ship and say exactly: Automated checks passed. Optional review links are available above. Say **Push Live** to deploy. Never merge or deploy before Push Live.
Bootstrap this repo for Codex only, preserve the fb-lane-coordination IDs and MCP paths, add any missing six-workstream guidance, then run doctor and report whether FB is ready.
